ja: ???: やっほー! あなた誰?
わたしの名前はヘザー!

key: COREY: I have told you a thousand times, do not speak to strangers.
en: COREY: I have told you a thousand times, do not speak to strangers.
ja: コーリー: 見知らぬ者に話しかけるなと、何度言えばわかる。

key: ???: I have told you a thousand times, do not speak to strangers.
en: ???: I have told you a thousand times, do not speak to strangers.
ja: ???: 見知らぬ者に話しかけるなと、何度言えばわかる。

key: Especially here, there is a veritable gaggle of degenerates who would not think twice about harming a young girl such as yourself.
en: Especially here, there is a veritable gaggle of degenerates who would not think twice about harming a young girl such as yourself.
ja: 特にこの辺りには、お前のような幼い娘を傷つけることを何とも思わないような、堕落した者どもがわんさかいるのだからな。

key: Am I or am I not clear?
en: Am I or am I not clear?
ja: わかったか、わからないのか、はっきりしろ。
はい、お父さん。
コーリー: 「はい」というのは、どちらに対してだ?
???: 「はい」というのは、どちらに対してだ?

key: HEATHER: I will not speak to strangers.
en: HEATHER: I will not speak to strangers.
ja: 見知らぬ人には話しかけません。

key: Or anyone ever, if you have your way...
en: Or anyone ever, if you have your way...
ja: お父さんの思い通りなら、誰にも話しかけられなくなりそうだけど……
コーリー: 何だと?

key: HEATHER: Forget it. I'm going home.
en: HEATHER: Forget it. I'm going home.
ja: もういい。家に帰る。
コーリー: ヘザー!
ちっ。

key: COREY: I don't know why you've come here, but whatever business you have, make it quick.
en: COREY: I don't know why you've come here, but whatever business you have, make it quick.
ja: コーリー: 何の用でここに来たのかは知らんが、用件があるなら手短に済ませろ。

key: Nothing good lurks in these wards anymore.
en: Nothing good lurks in these wards anymore.
ja: このワードにはもう、ろくなものは潜んでいない。
それは私自身も含めての話だ。

key: But children are always too rambunctious.
en: But children are always too rambunctious.
ja: だが、子供というのはいつだって無鉄砲すぎる。

key: They charge too forwardly into danger without ever knowing it's there, and then it is too late.
en: They charge too forwardly into danger without ever knowing it's there, and then it is too late.
ja: 危険があることも知らずに突っ込んでいって、気づいたときにはもう手遅れなのだ。

key: Naiveté is a poison most lethal.
en: Naiveté is a poison most lethal.
ja: 無邪気さこそ、最も致命的な毒だ。
その解毒剤は、決して心地よいものではない。

key: COREY: You never saw us here.
en: COREY: You never saw us here.
ja: コーリー: お前は、ここで我々を見なかった。
見たことすら忘れろ。

key: This is none of your business.
en: This is none of your business.
ja: お前には関係のないことだ。

key: One day, this will be a city worthy of its name again.
en: One day, this will be a city worthy of its name again.
ja: いつか、この街もまたその名に相応しい姿を取り戻すだろう。
本当に疲れた。

key: Every day we send men out to look for survivors.
en: Every day we send men out to look for survivors.
ja: 毎日、生存者を探しに人を送り出している。

key: Every day fewer come back than we sent out.
en: Every day fewer come back than we sent out.
ja: 毎日、送り出した数より帰ってくる数の方が少ない。

key: You shouldn't be out here this late!
en: You shouldn't be out here this late!
ja: こんな時間に出歩いてちゃだめだろう!
まあ、お前は大丈夫そうだけどな……
ほんと、疲れたよ……
<>-ウィローリード通り\n^-クリスタル通り
カイン: \PN!

key: I was so afraid I'd miss you.
en: I was so afraid I'd miss you.
ja: 会えないんじゃないかって、マジで焦ったよねぇ。

key: Do you already know what happened?
en: Do you already know what happened?
ja: もう何が起きたか知ってる?

key: CAIN: Ah, why don't we take this inside?
en: CAIN: Ah, why don't we take this inside?
ja: カイン: あ、この話、中でしようか。
周りに人がいるしさ。
<>-ヘザーヒル小道\nv-イエロー通り
<>-ヘザーヒル小道\nv-クリスタル通り
リボーンシティ警察署
ガルルルッ!?
ヘザー: ってことで、こんにちは!

key: I saw you beat that bad guy!
en: I saw you beat that bad guy!
ja: あの悪い奴をやっつけるとこ見てたよ!

key: You did so-so, but I think you have potential!
en: You did so-so, but I think you have potential!
ja: まあまあって感じだったけど、素質はあると思う!

key: Wanna team up and take on some more?
en: Wanna team up and take on some more?
ja: 組んでもっとやっつけに行かない?

key: My dad thinks I went home, so I should have at least a little time.
en: My dad thinks I went home, so I should have at least a little time.
ja: お父さんはわたしが家に帰ったと思ってるから、少しくらいなら時間あるはず。

key: His name is Corey, if you didn't know,
en: His name is Corey, if you didn't know,
ja: 知らないかもしれないけど、お父さんの名前はコーリー。

key: But everyone else is always calling him things like "Dr. Molinar" or "Officer Molinar".
en: But everyone else is always calling him things like "Dr. Molinar" or "Officer Molinar".
ja: でもみんなはいつも「モリナー博士」とか「モリナー巡査」とか呼んでる。

key: He doesn't even have a badge though!
en: He doesn't even have a badge though!
ja: バッジすら持ってないのに!
みんなバカみたい。

key: Anyway, bad guys! Wanna beat 'em up?
en: Anyway, bad guys! Wanna beat 'em up?
ja: それで、悪い奴らのことだけど! やっつけに行く?
ヘザー: やった!

key: HEATHER: What? Why not, what's wrong with you?
en: HEATHER: What? Why not, what's wrong with you?
ja: ヘザー: え? なんでダメなの、どうしたの?
もしかしてあなたが悪い人?
ヘザー: ……
うーん……
うーーーーーーーーーーん……

key: Nah, you don't look like it.
en: Nah, you don't look like it.
ja: ううん、そうは見えないや。

key: Otherwise why were you fighting them in there?
en: Otherwise why were you fighting them in there?
ja: じゃなきゃ、なんであの中で戦ってたわけ?
でも、いいジョークだったよ!
ヘザー: じゃあ何が問題なの!?

key: Come on, let's go! They're over this way!
en: Come on, let's go! They're over this way!
ja: さ、行こう! こっちの方にいるよ!

key: Nothing to do but try to patch up these streets...
en: Nothing to do but try to patch up these streets...
ja: この通りを直すしかないよな……
石を一つずつ、って感じか?
……そう　定められていたのだ

key: You know, it's not like I even mind the extra trees and stuff.
en: You know, it's not like I even mind the extra trees and stuff.
ja: まあ、木とかが増えるのも別に嫌じゃないんだよな。
なんかいい感じ?
慣れちゃいそう。
エモンガは眠っているようだ。

key: Do you want to try to take Emolga?
en: Do you want to try to take Emolga?
ja: エモンガを捕まえてみますか?
エモンガ: グー……エモ……エモン……?
目を覚ましたポケモンが攻撃してきた!
<>-ヘザーヒル小道\nv-プラチナ通り

key: These doors open to the Tourmaline Desert... Only for the train of course. It's unlikely that they'll open again for a while...
en: These doors open to the Tourmaline Desert... Only for the train of course. It's unlikely that they'll open again for a while...
ja: この扉はトルマリン砂漠へと通じている……もちろん、開くのは列車のためだけだ。しばらくはもう開かないだろう……

key: The desert is vast and unforgiving... It can't be trusted. Truly, it is outside of humankind's territory.
en: The desert is vast and unforgiving... It can't be trusted. Truly, it is outside of humankind's territory.
ja: あの砂漠は広大で、容赦がない……信用できない場所だ。まさに、人類の領域の外にある。

key: Roger, standing by for future orders regarding the Sylveon... \nHold on, we have a suspicious person in the area!
en: Roger, standing by for future orders regarding the Sylveon... \nHold on, we have a suspicious person in the area!
ja: 了解、ニンフィアに関する今後の指示を待機中……\nちょっと待て、この辺りに不審者がいる!
了解、どうぞ。
混信がひどいな……
<-ウィローリード通り\n^-プラチナ通り
子供: きゃあああ! 助けて! お願い!
スウォーム: シャアアア……
子供: ……

key: Oh my god you are so amazing, you took on all three of those bugs by yourself and you totally saved me, oh my god, thank you so much, thank you thank you!
en: Oh my god you are so amazing, you took on all three of those bugs by yourself and you totally saved me, oh my god, thank you so much, thank you thank you!
ja: うわあ、すごい、本当にすごい、三匹の虫を全部一人でやっつけて、完全にわたしを助けてくれた、本当にありがとう、ありがとう、本当にありがとう!

key: I was on my way home and those gross things cornered me.
en: I was on my way home and those gross things cornered me.
ja: 家に帰る途中で、あの気持ち悪い奴らに追い詰められちゃって。

key: But I'm sure I can make it there now.
en: But I'm sure I can make it there now.
ja: でも、これでちゃんと帰れそう。

key: Thank you so much for saving me!
en: Thank you so much for saving me!
ja: 助けてくれて本当にありがとう!
バイバイ!
ああ……植物は引いたのか?

key: A vine became violent when I approached it, and when it ripped through the ground, I was trapped back here.
en: A vine became violent when I approached it, and when it ripped through the ground, I was trapped back here.
ja: 近づいたらツルが暴れ出して、地面を突き破ったせいで、ここに閉じ込められてしまったんだ。

key: I suppose it's safe to leave now, though? I've got to get back to the station!
en: I suppose it's safe to leave now, though? I've got to get back to the station!
ja: もう出ても安全そうだな? 署に戻らないと!
<>-ウィローリード通り\n^-イエロー通り
はい
いいえ
